titleEn: Gently with a Baby on the Sled!

pages.text: "Hop on, little squirrel! I will pull!" Gugu, the broad-chested pigeon, took the sled rope. The last snow covered the hill. The baby squirrel, smaller than all three, settled onto the sled.
Gugu wanted exciting fun with the squirrel. With the rope trailing long, Gugu ran hard. Behind, the sled swung from side to side.
Bump! The sled hit a snowball. The squirrel tipped back into the snow. Gugu stopped, still gripping the rope.
The squirrel sat crying in the snow. Kiki, the pointy-eared cat, ran over and brushed snow from the face. Gugu could not speak.
"One more ride!" Gugu brought the sled. The squirrel shook the head and hid behind Kiki.
Gugu pulled the empty sled uphill alone. So light with nobody behind. Not fun at all.
At the top, Gugu sat looking at the long rope. Gugu wanted the squirrel back on board. "It is no fun alone..."
Grandpa climbed up with a snow shovel on his shoulder. "With a rope this long, what happens behind you?" "It swings everywhere!" Gugu wound the rope shorter.
Gugu showed the short rope. The squirrel sat on the sled again. "One, short rope! Two, look ahead and go slowly! Three, look back for a baby smile!" Gugu pulled gently.
The squirrel laughed and snuggled into Gugu's arms. Go slowly, and the baby behind you smiles. Gugu tugged the green bag strap. "Gently with a baby on the sled!"
